d: Pertaining to Aonia, Boeotia, or to the Muses, who were supposed to dwell there. Aonian fount, the fountain of Aganippe, at the foot of Mount Helicon, not far from Thebes, and sacred to the Muses.
w.e: From Aonia, a part of Boeotia, in Greece.

d: Etym: [Gr. (Gram.) “A tense in the Greek language, which expresses an action as completed in past time, but leaves it, in other respects, wholly indeterminate.”

n: a verb tense in some languages (classical Greek and Sanskrit) expressing action (especially past action) without indicating its completion or continuation

d: Etym: [Gr. “Indefinite; pertaining to the aorist tense.”

n: of or relating to the aorist tense

d: Etym: [NL., fr. Gr. (Anat.) “The great artery which carries the blood from the heart to all parts of the body except the lungs; the main trunk of the arterial system.”

n: the large trunk artery that carries blood from the left ventricle of the heart to branch arteries

d: Of or pertaining to the aorta.

n: of or relating to the aorta
of or relating to the aorta
